claim.en: Martin Kusenda has been director of the Old Theatre of Karol Spišák in Nitra since 15 June 2015, chosen in a selection procedure.

claim.en: Martin Kusenda, a 44-year-old theatre director running as an independent, got 2.68% in the 2022 Nitra region governor election.
